windows.text: L-Glutamine (watch Dr. Rhonda vid) ... The 5g also counters the breakdown of the gut lining that hard or long training causes, like CrossFit or intense cardio.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: While you train, your body sends blood away from your gut to your working muscles, so your enterocytes get less of the oxygen and fuel that blood brings them.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: The glutamine you swallow reaches them from inside your gut instead.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: If your immune system is dealing with an acute exposure, if your whole system is under a lot of stress, or if you have active IBD (Crohn's or colitis), raise it gradually to 10-30g a day.
